mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT team_post_id, COUNT(1) AS accepted_count FROM team_member WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY team_post_id ) mc ON mc.team_post_id = t.id
CASE WHEN t.status = 0 THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(mc.accepted_count, 0) >= t.member_limit THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS status
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_post (user_id, title, description, rating_min, rating_max, region, tags, member_limit, status, deleted) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{ratingMin}, #{ratingMax}, #{region}, #{tags}, #{memberLimit}, #{status}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, description, rating_min, rating_max, region, tags, member_limit, status, created_time, updated_time, deleted FROM team_post WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT t.id, t.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS authorName, t.title, t.description, t.rating_min AS ratingMin, t.rating_max AS ratingMax, t.region, t.tags, t.member_limit AS memberLimit, , , t.created_time AS createdTime FROM team_post t INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = t.user_id AND u.deleted = 0
WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.deleted = 0

SELECT t.id, t.user_id AS userId, COALESCE(u.nickname, u.username) AS authorName, t.title, t.description, t.rating_min AS ratingMin, t.rating_max AS ratingMax, t.region, t.tags, t.member_limit AS memberLimit, , , t.created_time AS createdTime
